name: [FIXED!🛠] first to join gets owner admin!
desc:
[+] We have fixed the issue where admin commands weren't working properly. We are so sorry that it took us a while to fix this!

🏆 ONLY THE FIRST PLAYER GETS OWNER ADMIN! FREE PRIVATE SERVERS!

🎉 This is a hangout game, where only one person can be the owner! You can use moderation commands like :kick, :ban, and so on! The only commands that are off limits are :permban and other commands that may affect other servers or game functions!

This game uses the Adonis Admin module, the best admin system to-date, with the most amount of fun commands!

😎 If you are the first player to join, you own the game! Build your game and rule your world!
👑 You have the freedom to rule your own server; remember to play nice and be fair!
🤩 Build your own game from the ground up, and catch the eye of players by making your game interesting!

😁 Enjoy your time! - Caleb
